# Getting Started

## Installation

ArthOMix Explorer is a classic Shiny app (not a package), with dependencies
pinned via [renv](https://rstudio.github.io/renv/).

### Requirements

- R (version ≥ 4.4, matching the Bioconductor release used in `renv.lock`)
- [renv](https://rstudio.github.io/renv/) for reproducible package installation

### Steps

1. Clone the repository and open it in R (or RStudio) at the repo root.
2. Install `renv` if you don't already have it:

   ```r
   install.packages("renv")
   ```

3. Restore the exact package versions recorded in `ArthOMix/renv.lock`:

   ```r
   renv::restore(project = "ArthOMix")
   ```

   This installs all CRAN and Bioconductor dependencies listed in
   `ArthOMix/DESCRIPTION` (shiny, DT, plotly, limma, minfi, WGCNA, MOFA2,
   and the rest of the transcriptomics/methylomics/multiomics stack) at the
   pinned versions.

4. Launch the app (see [Running the app](#running-the-app)).

## Loading data

Every module reads from one shared, in-session dataset. There are two ways to populate it:

1. **Use the preloaded example dataset** — every module works immediately against a built-in example so you can explore the app before bringing your own data. This is the default on first launch.
2. **Upload your own data** — from the **Dataset** tab within Transcriptomics (Chapter \@ref(transcriptomics-dataset)) or Methylomics (Chapter \@ref(methylomics-dataset)), depending on which track you're working in.
